All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AesGcmKeyCipher
Encrypts and decrypts the private half of signing keys with AES-256-GCM (Spring Security's Encryptors.stronger).
AesGcmTotpSecretCipher
TotpSecretCipher that encrypts TOTP secrets with AES-256 in GCM mode.
CachedJwkSet
A JSON Web Key set loaded lazily and kept in memory for a short time, so that verifying or signing a token does not read the database every time.
DatabaseJwkSourceConfiguration
Serves the signing keys kept by the key use cases.
DevKeyEncryptionSecret
Provides the key-encryption inputs when the dev profile is active, so a developer does not have to configure anything: a random passphrase and salt are generated once per machine, stored in a file under ~/.irurueta-auth-server/ that only the owner can read, and reused at every start, which keeps the signing keys persisted in the development database decryptable across restarts.
HmacTrustedDeviceTokenSigner
TrustedDeviceTokenSigner that signs the trusted-device cookie with HMAC-SHA256, under a key derived from the key-encryption secret for this purpose only (PurposeKeyDerivation).
JwkCacheRefreshListener
Drops every cached JWK set when the signing keys rotate, so the next token or JWKS request sees the new keys without waiting for the cache to expire.
KeyEncryptionConfiguration
Reads the key-encryption inputs from configuration (authserver.keys.encryption.password and authserver.keys.encryption.salt, taken from the environment in production).
KeyEncryptionProperties
Inputs of the encryption of private signing keys at rest.
NimbusSignedTokenService
Issues and verifies purpose-bound tokens as JWTs signed with the active signing key and verified against the published keys.
PurposeKeyDerivation
Derives, from the key-encryption secret (KeyEncryptionProperties), a distinct salt and key for each purpose other than the encryption of signing keys, so no two uses share a key: a key exposed or misused for one purpose says nothing about the others.
RsaSigningKeyGenerator
Generates RSA signing keys for the RS256 algorithm.
SecureTokenGenerator
TokenGenerator that creates tokens from a SecureRandom and hashes them with SHA-256.
SigningKeyJwkMapper
Maps the domain SigningKey onto Nimbus JSON Web Keys: the public set lists the public half of every key it is given, whereas the signing set holds the single active key with its private half, decrypted with the AesGcmKeyCipher.
